summary_1line: After Ghatotkacha routs the Kaurava army with illusion, Duryodhana seeks Bhishma’s help, leading Bhagadatta to charge the Pandavas on his elephant Supratika.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ghatotkacha unleashes a terrifying illusion as Kaurava warriors see their comrades lying slain and the army fleeing in panic.
King Bhagadatta charges into battle atop his massive elephant Supratika, towering over the battlefield like Indra riding Airavata.
Enraged elephants with streaming temples clash tusk to tusk while chariots, horses, and infantry collide amid a storm of arrows.
